Diamond Springs Ranch • Sedgwick, Kansas

The most unforgettable date night in Kansas.

A private evening at the ranch — the most unique dinner date near Wichita.

Book the Dinner Date Ask a Question
Scroll

A table at a restaurant is fine. A private evening on a working Kansas ranch as the sun drops behind the pasture — horses visible from the table, the Highlands moving through the field, the Sedgwick County sky going gold — that’s something else entirely. We built the Dinner Date Experience for the couples who want more than dinner. They want a moment that actually sticks.

We started Diamond Springs Ranch so people could slow down. That’s what the Dinner Date does better than anything else we offer. No screens pulling you away. No noise from the table next to you. Just the two of you, this land, and an evening that reminds you what presence actually feels like.

You ride at sunset. You come back to a private dinner. There’s a fire. The Rusty Saddle Bar is on site. And if you want to make a full weekend of it, we can pair the dinner date with a night in the treehouse or the covered wagon — one phone call and we’ll build the whole thing around you.

Booking the Dinner Date

By reservation only — call or text (316) 303-6195. Spring and fall weekends fill up fast. If you’re planning for an anniversary, Valentine’s Day, or a milestone, don’t wait. Call ahead, tell us what you’re going for, and we’ll take it from there.

Where Are We?

Diamond Springs Ranch, 1734 SE 96th St, Sedgwick, KS 67135. Fifteen minutes north of Wichita. Fully insured, reservation-only. From our family to yours.

More to explore: Guided Horseback Rides, Highland Cattle Experience, Luxury Treehouse Stay, Covered Wagon Stay, Private Events. See all ranch experiences and areas we serve.

★★★★★
“Our stay at the ranch was nothing short of amazing. We got to go on a peaceful, beautiful horseback ride, the whole experience was incredibly calming. Dinner was fantastic-perfectly cooked steak with vegetables and a potato, followed by little cheesecake bites that were the perfect dessert. They even made a fire for us afterward, which made the evening feel warm and cozy. We spent the night in one of their wagon rooms, and it was wonderfully comfortable, unique, and relaxing. They also worked really well with our schedule for booking everything, which made everything even easier and more enjoyable. Every single person we interacted with was welcoming, friendly, and extremely attentive. You can truly tell they care about making your experience special. Common Questions

Frequently asked questions.

What is the Dinner Date Experience?+
A private evening at the ranch combining the setting, the animals, and a dining experience that doesn’t exist at any restaurant near Wichita. Call (316) 303-6195 for current details and pricing.
Is it good for anniversaries?+
It’s our most popular anniversary booking. Open Kansas land, working horses, the quiet of the property at dusk — it’s unlike anything at a restaurant.
How far out should I book?+
Weekend dates book fast in spring and fall. At least 2–3 weeks out is smart for weekend evenings. Call (316) 303-6195 to check availability.
Can I combine it with an overnight stay?+
Yes — pairing the Dinner Date with the treehouse or covered wagon is one of our most popular combinations. Call and we’ll put it together.
Is it available year-round?+
It varies by season. Call (316) 303-6195 to check what’s available for your time of year.
